name: riaf-vscode
description: Semantic repository indexing (BM25 + embeddings, context graph) exposed as Copilot tools, an @riaf read-edit-test agent, and an MCP server for Claude Code. Fully offline-capable; corporate-proxy friendly.

chatParticipants.name: riaf
chatParticipants.description: Plan → gather (RIAF search) → edit → verify, with token discipline

commands.name: plan
commands.description: Only produce a plan; make no edits

commands.name: explain
commands.description: Explain the relevant code using the index; no edits

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Run the project's test/typecheck commands and report

languageModelTools.name: riaf_search_codebase
languageModelTools.userDescription: Hybrid BM25 + semantic search over the indexed workspace, with identifier-aware tokenisation.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search the indexed repository for code chunks relevant to a natural-language or identifier query. Returns ranked chunks with file path, line range and content. Prefer this over reading many files blindly.

query.description: What to look for — identifiers, concepts, error strings

pathPrefix.description: Restrict to files under this relative path

languageModelTools.name: riaf_context_profile
languageModelTools.userDescription: Related files, importers/imports and covering tests for a file, plus a workspace summary.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get the contextual profile for a file: files it imports, files that import it, tests that cover it, and the workspace profile (languages, frameworks, build/test commands). Call before editing a file.

filePath.description: Workspace-relative path; omit for the workspace-level profile only

languageModelTools.name: riaf_search_symbols
languageModelTools.userDescription: Find exported symbols (functions, classes, types) by name.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Find exported symbols by name or partial name across the workspace. Returns symbol kind, file and line.

commands.title: RIAF: Set up Claude Code (MCP + plugin)
RIAF: Rewind (restore files / conversation from a checkpoint)

riaf.index.autoIndexOnStartup.description: Index the workspace when VS Code opens (incremental after the first run).

riaf.index.watch.description: Keep the index up to date as files change.

riaf.index.respectGitignore.description: Skip files matched by .gitignore (root and nested) while indexing.

riaf.index.treeSitter.description: Chunk code and extract symbols from the syntax tree (tree-sitter). Falls back to regex heuristics per language when a grammar is unavailable.

riaf.index.excludeGlobs.description: gitignore-style patterns to skip while indexing.

riaf.embeddings.enabled.description: Use embeddings for semantic retrieval (needs the gateway). Off = BM25-only, fully offline.

riaf.embeddings.model.description: Embedding model name as known to the gateway.

riaf.gateway.url.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL of the internal LLM gateway, e.g. https://llm-gateway.internal/v1. Leave empty to use the models exposed by Copilot (vscode.lm).

riaf.gateway.model.description: Chat model id at the gateway (e.g. anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-5). Used only when riaf.gateway.url is set.

enumDescriptions: Entra ID token via VS Code's built-in Microsoft sign-in
GitHub token via VS Code's built-in GitHub sign-in
riaf.gateway.auth.description: How to authenticate to the gateway.

riaf.gateway.ssoScopes.description: Scopes requested from the SSO provider; set to your gateway's API scope (e.g. api://<app-id>/.default).

riaf.gateway.headers.description: Extra headers to send to the gateway.

riaf.gateway.promptCache.description: Apply Anthropic cache_control breakpoints when the gateway routes to Claude models.

riaf.gateway.stream.description: Stream gateway responses (SSE) so text appears as it is generated. Turn off for gateways that do not support stream=true.

riaf.agent.maxIterations.description: Hard cap on tool-call iterations per @riaf request.

riaf.agent.maxReadOnlyCalls.description: Cap on exploration (read/search/list) calls before the agent is nudged to act.

riaf.agent.generatePlan.description: Produce a short plan (≤300 tokens) before acting and tick items off as tools run.

riaf.agent.autoVerify.description: After edits, run the detected test/typecheck command and feed results back.

riaf.agent.requireEditApproval.description: Show edits as a diff the developer accepts before writing to disk.

riaf.agent.allowRunCommand.description: Allow the agent to run shell commands (asks before each one).

riaf.agent.contextWindowRatio.description: Fraction of the model context window the agent may fill before trimming.

riaf.agent.diagnosticsAfterEdit.description: After each edit, wait briefly for the language server and return its errors/warnings for that file in the tool result.

riaf.agent.autoApproveDetectedTestComman.description: Let the detected test / typecheck / lint command run without a confirmation dialog.

riaf.agent.preApprovedCommands.description: Commands (or command prefixes, e.g. "npm test", "npx vitest") the agent may run without asking.

riaf.agent.denyCommandPatterns.description: Additional regular expressions; a matching shell command is always refused (built-in list covers rm -rf /, sudo, force push, …).

riaf.agent.sandbox.description: Workspace-write sandbox for shell commands. policy: refuse commands that write outside the workspace. seatbelt: additionally enforce it with macOS sandbox-exec. auto: seatbelt where available, else policy.

riaf.agent.hooks.description: Hooks (also read from .riaf/hooks.json): { preTool: [{ matcher, command }], postEdit: [{ matcher, command }] }. A preTool hook blocks a call with exit code 2 or stdout {"decision":"block"}.

riaf.agent.summarizeHistory.description: When a thread grows past ~60% of the budget, replace the oldest turns with a model-written summary instead of dropping them (falls back to dropping if the summary call fails).

riaf.agent.exploreSubagent.description: Expose the read-only `explore` subagent tool: a side loop that searches and reads, then returns a short report so the main thread stays small.

riaf.agent.checkpoints.description: Snapshot files before the agent edits them so a turn can be rewound (RIAF: Rewind).

scripts.package: npm run typecheck && node esbuild.mjs --production && npm run vendor && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --out ../../riaf-vscode-0.1.0.vsix
